items.source: key - the context key; never null
items.translation: key - 上下文键；永远不为 null

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of put(MergedContextConfiguration, LoadFunction)
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 put(MergedContextConfiguration, LoadFunction)

items.source: Clear hit count and miss count statistics for the cache (i.e., reset counters to zero).
items.translation: 清除缓存的命中计数和未命中计数统计信息（即，将计数器重置为零）。

items.source: The default implementation of this method always returns 0. Concrete implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method, registerContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class), and unregisterContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class) with appropriate behavior. Note that the standard ContextContext implementation in Spring overrides these methods appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现始终返回 `0`。因此，强烈建议具体实现类重写此方法，并配合适当的行为实现 registerContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class) 和 unregisterContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class)。请注意，Spring 中的标准 `ContextContext` 实现已适当重写了这些方法。

items.source: A ContextCache maintains a cache of ApplicationContexts keyed by MergedContextConfiguration instances, potentially configured with a maximum size and a custom eviction policy.
items.translation: ContextCache 维护一个由 MergedContextConfiguration 实例作为键的 ApplicationContexts 缓存，该缓存可能配置了最大大小和自定义驱逐策略。

items.source: The default implementation of this method does nothing. Concrete implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method, unregisterContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class), and getContextUsageCount() with appropriate behavior. Note that the standard ContextContext implementation in Spring overrides these methods appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现什么都不做。因此，强烈建议具体实现覆盖此方法、unregisterContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class) 和 getContextUsageCount()，以提供适当的行为。请注意，Spring 中的标准 ContextContext 实现已适当地覆盖了这些方法。

items.source: The default implementation of this method does nothing. Concrete implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method, registerContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class), and getContextUsageCount() with appropriate behavior. Note that the standard ContextContext implementation in Spring overrides these methods appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现什么都不做。因此，强烈建议具体实现覆盖此方法、registerContextUsage(MergedContextConfiguration, Class) 和 getContextUsageCount()，并采用适当的行为。请注意，Spring 中的标准 ContextContext 实现已适当地覆盖了这些方法。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, this SPI includes optional support for tracking and incrementing failure counts. As of Spring Framework 7.0, this SPI includes optional support for registering and unregistering context usage.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，此 SPI 包含用于跟踪和增加失败计数的可选支持。自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，此 SPI 包含用于注册和注销上下文使用的可选支持。

items.source: The default implementation of this method always returns 0. Concrete implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method and incrementFailureCount(MergedContextConfiguration) with appropriate behavior. Note that the standard ContextContext implementation in Spring overrides these methods appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现始终返回 `0`。因此，强烈建议具体实现覆盖此方法，并使用适当的行为调用 incrementFailureCount(MergedContextConfiguration)。请注意，Spring 中的标准 `ContextContext` 实现已适当地覆盖了这些方法。

items.source: The supplied ContextCache.LoadFunction will be invoked to load the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 提供的 `ContextCache.LoadFunction` 将被调用以加载`ApplicationContext`。

items.source: In addition, the semantics of the supplied HierarchyMode must be honored. See the Javadoc for DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode for details.
items.translation: 此外，必须遵守所提供的 `HierarchyMode` 的语义。有关详细信息，请参阅 DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode 的 Javadoc。

items.source: A failure is any attempt to load the ApplicationContext for the given key that results in an exception.
items.translation: 失败是指尝试加载给定键的ApplicationContext并导致异常的任何操作。

items.source: The default implementation of this method does nothing. Concrete implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method and getFailureCount(MergedContextConfiguration) with appropriate behavior. Note that the standard ContextContext implementation in Spring overrides these methods appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现什么都不做。因此，强烈建议具体实现覆盖此方法，并使用适当的行为getFailureCount(MergedContextConfiguration)。请注意，Spring 中的标准 ContextContext 实现已适当地覆盖了这些方法。

items.source: May alternatively be configured via the SpringProperties mechanism.
items.translation: 也可以通过 SpringProperties 机制进行配置。

items.source: If the cached application context was previously paused, it must be restarted. This applies to parent contexts as well.
items.translation: 如果缓存的应用程序上下文之前处于暂停状态，则必须对其进行重启。此规则同样适用于父上下文。

items.source: In addition, the hit and miss counts must be updated accordingly.
items.translation: 此外，还必须相应地更新命中和未命中计数。

items.source: If the cache contains more than Integer.MAX_VALUE elements, this method must return Integer.MAX_VALUE.
items.translation: 如果缓存包含的元素数量超过 `Integer.MAX_VALUE`，此方法必须返回 `Integer.MAX_VALUE`。

items.source: A miss is any access to the cache that returns a null context for the queried key.
items.translation: 未命中（miss）是指对缓存的任何访问，该访问为查询的键返回了 `null` 上下文。

items.source: Context caching can have significant performance benefits if context initialization is complex. Although the initialization of a Spring context itself is typically very quick, some beans in a context — for example, an embedded database or a LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean for working with JPA — may take several seconds to initialize. Hence, it often makes sense to perform that initialization only once per test suite or JVM process.
items.translation: 如果上下文初始化过程复杂，上下文缓存可以带来显著的性能提升。虽然 Spring 上下文的初始化本身通常非常快，但上下文中的某些 Bean——例如嵌入式数据库或用于处理 JPA 的 `<code>LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean`——可能需要数秒才能完成初始化。因此，通常建议仅在测试套件或 JVM 进程中执行一次该初始化。

items.source: Note that implementations of ContextCache are not required to actually support a maximum cache size. Consult the documentation of the corresponding implementation for details.
items.translation: 注意，ContextCache 的实现并不一定需要实际支持最大缓存大小。请查阅相应实现的文档以获取详细信息。

items.source: Concrete implementations which honor a custom eviction policy must override this method to ensure that an evicted context is removed from the cache and closed before a new context is loaded via the supplied LoadFunction.
items.translation: 实现自定义驱逐策略的具体实现必须重写此方法，以确保在通过提供的`LoadFunction`加载新上下文之前，从缓存中移除并关闭被驱逐的上下文。

items.source: If no other test classes are actively using the same application context(s), the application context(s) should be paused.
items.translation: 如果没有其他测试类正在使用相同的应用程序上下文，则应用程序上下文应处于暂停状态。

items.source: A hit is any access to the cache that returns a non-null context for the queried key.
items.translation: 命中是指对缓存的任何访问，该访问为查询的键返回非空上下文。

items.source:
Generally speaking, this method should be called to properly evict
a context from the cache (for example, due to a custom eviction policy) or if
the state of a singleton bean has been modified, potentially affecting
future interaction with the context.
items.translation: 一般来说，应调用此方法以正确从缓存中驱逐上下文（例如，由于自定义驱逐策略），或者如果单例 Bean 的状态已修改并可能影响与上下文的未来交互。

items.source: The following information should be logged.
items.translation: 应记录以下信息。

items.source: Register usage of the ApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and any of its parents.
items.translation: 注册为提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 及其任何父级使用的 ApplicationContext。

items.source: Unregister usage of the ApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and any of its parents.
items.translation: 取消注册为提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 及其任何父级注册的 ApplicationContext 的使用。

items.source: Log the statistics for this ContextCache at DEBUG level using the "org.springframework.test.context.cache" logging category.
items.translation: 在此级别记录此ContextCache的统计信息，使用"org.springframework.test.context.cache"日志类别。

items.source: Represents a function that loads an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 表示一个用于加载 `ApplicationContext` 的函数。

items.source: System property used to configure the maximum size of the ContextCache as a positive integer: "spring.test.context.cache.maxSize".
items.translation: 用于配置ContextCache最大大小的系统属性，需为正整数："spring.test.context.cache.maxSize"。

items.source: Obtain a cached ApplicationContext for the given key.
items.translation: 获取给定键的缓存的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Explicitly add an ApplicationContext to the cache under the given key, potentially honoring a custom eviction policy.
items.translation: 在给定键下的缓存中显式添加一个ApplicationContext，可能会遵守自定义的驱逐策略。

items.source: The name of the logging category used for reporting ContextCache statistics.
items.translation: 用于报告 `ContextCache` 统计信息的日志分类名称。

items.source: The default maximum size of the context cache: 32.
items.translation: 上下文缓存的默认最大大小：32。

items.source: Clear all contexts from the cache, clearing context hierarchy information as well.
items.translation: 清除缓存中的所有上下文，同时清除上下文层次结构信息。

items.source: Determine whether there is a cached context for the given key.
items.translation: 确定给定键是否存在缓存上下文。

items.source: Determine the number of parent contexts currently tracked within the cache.
items.translation: 确定当前在缓存中跟踪的父上下文数量。

items.source: Reset all state maintained by this cache including statistics.
items.translation: 重置此缓存维护的所有状态，包括统计信息。

items.translation: loadFunction - 一个用于加载指定键上下文的函数；永远不会为 null。

items.translation: 获取此缓存的整体缺失计数。

items.translation: 递增给定键的失败计数。

items.translation: 确定当前缓存中存储的上下文数量。

items.translation: hierarchyMode - 层次模式；如果上下文不属于层次结构，则可能为 null。
